inputs.share_count_basis: 986m FPO + 6.5m options/incentives per Aug-2026 Diggers & Dealers presentation (fully diluted). Dec-2025 balance-sheet count of 835.6m is stale — Feb-2026 A$130m placement @ A$0.90 (+144.4m) and A$4.1m SPP (+4.6m) reconcile 835.6m -> ~986m.
inputs.net_debt_note: Net cash ~A$185m per Aug-2026 presentation ('net cash at bank'), used in preference to the Dec-2025 balance sheet (A$90.0m cash) because of the Feb-2026 A$134.1m raise. Only debt is A$0.37m of IFRS-16 leases.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 reported FCF (A$-19.0m) is exploration/development spend, NOT a valuation input. This company is pre-revenue; no FCF-based projection is possible or attempted.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report (A$0.62m); immaterial to a risked-NAV model — house and street bases coincide
inputs.fx_note: Company reports in AUD and the PFS is in AUD; SMI.NZ quotes in NZD. All per-share values computed in AUD then converted at AUD/NZD 1.2123 (Yahoo AUDNZD=X, 2026-09-01; 52wk 1.1066-1.228). Dual-listed: SMI.AX quotes AUD (A$0.51, parity check 0.51 x 1.2123 = NZ$0.618 vs NZ$0.615 — holds).
inputs.balance_sheet_date: 2025-12-31 (H1 FY2026), superseded for cash/shares by Aug-2026 presentation figures as noted
inputs.notes: MODEL: risked project-NPV (sum-of-parts) — equity = P(permit) x project NPV + net cash + raise proceeds - dilution - overhead. None of the dcf-methods routing rows fit: Santana is a pre-revenue single-asset gold developer awaiting a binary Fast-track Approvals Act decision (due 16-Dec-2026). An owner-FCF DCF is meaningless here (every historical FCF is negative exploration spend); the asset-waterfall row is for dead companies, and this one holds a fully-engineered project. Scenarios are framed on the permit outcome, not growth rates. Project cash-flow profile reconstructed from PFS Figure 3 (annual FCF at A$4,950/oz) and rescaled to scenario gold prices via the PFS's own revenue flow-through (87.4% pre-tax after royalty drag, 28% tax); calibrates to within 2% of published NPVs (A$735m vs A$732m time-shifted at A$3,500; A$1,403m vs A$1,428m at A$4,950).

risk_charging_map.time_value_single_asset_execution_ramp: equity discount rate ONLY (12% real base / 10% real bull vs PFS 6.5% project rate)
risk_charging_map.cost_overrun: explicit A$28m deduction in base (capex +10% beyond the PFS's 10% contingency) ONLY
risk_charging_map.financing_dilution: explicit share-count modelling ONLY (base: A$140m equity @ A$0.70 -> +200m shares)
risk_charging_map.gold_price: scenario gold price assumptions ONLY (base A$4,500 vs spot ~A$6,000)

inputs.discount_rate_build_up: Real terms (PFS flows are unescalated real AUD; PFS's 6.5% is also real). Base 12% real ~= nominal 14.3%: NZ risk-free 4.3% + 5% ERP x 1.2 beta + 2.5% single-asset construction/ramp-up premium + 1.5% small-cap illiquidity, less ~2.3% inflation. Bull 10% real assumes clean execution. Permit risk is deliberately NOT in the rate — it is charged once, via the 30% bear weight.

historical_growth.notes: Pre-revenue developer: every historical CAGR describes equity raises and exploration spend, not a business trajectory. Equity 'grew' 20x since FY2019 purely by issuance (share count 23m -> 992m). All CAGRs deliberately null.

base.scenario: Permit granted with ~6-month slippage/conditions (decision drifts into H1-2027, construction from late-2027)
base.funding: All-equity gap: A$140m raised @ A$0.70 (+200m shares); covers A$277m capex + working-capital/overrun buffer vs A$185m cash
base.terminal_note: Finite 13.8-year mine life; no terminal value. Exploration upside (RAS North, 380km2 tenure) deliberately excluded — it offsets tail-year risk.

bull.scenario: Permit granted on time (16-Dec-2026); strong gold sustained; project debt does the heavy lifting
bull.funding: A$100m project debt (A$10m fees/friction charged; lender technical DD already underway) + A$25m equity @ A$0.90 (+27.8m shares)
bull.gold_note: A$5,500/oz is deliberately BELOW spot ~A$5,900-6,200 — a sustained-strength assumption, not an annualised spike. Management's A$2.1bn NPV headline uses A$6,000/oz and is indicative commentary, not a re-issued study.

bear.scenario: Permit refused, application voided under s7 (Treaty/iwi challenge), or delayed beyond commercial viability
bear.components_note: Not zero: A$185m cash, ~3,680ha freehold Central Otago farmland (OIO consent May-2026) resaleable near cost, and a 2.34Moz defined resource retaining re-application/change-of-government/sale option value (~US$7-8/oz — deeply discounted for the hostile precedent). A$71m capitalised E&E treated as ~worthless. Equity A$200m ~= 0.9x tangible ex-E&E book.

projections.note: Project-level annual free cash flow (A$m, real, incl. tax and all capex) reconstructed from PFS Figure 3 and rescaled to scenario gold. Y-2/Y-1 are the 14-month pre-production build (A$277m capex net of early-works). Discount factors are from the valuation date at each scenario's equity rate and timing shift.

bear.note: No project cash flows — value is the asset bridge in assumptions.bear

entry_price.method_note: Standard TV-at-WACC formula does not apply (no terminal value, finite mine). Adaptation: each scenario IV already compounds at its equity rate, so the price clearing a 15% hurdle over the ~3-year realisation window (decision -> first gold -> ramp) is IV x ((1+r_scenario)/1.15)^3.
entry_price.note: Weighted entry NZ$0.817 sits ABOVE the current NZ$0.615: on these probability weights the expected return at today's price clears 15%/yr. The compensation demanded is for variance — a 30% chance of ~NZ$0.24 — not for a deficient expected value.

required_return_table.note: Base-scenario NZD/share at alternative real equity discount rates, funding structure held constant

sensitivity.axes_note: Rows = long-run gold price (A$/oz), columns = real equity discount rate (%). Base-scenario structure (granted, 6-mo delay, A$140m raise @ A$0.70). Values NZD/share, UNWEIGHTED for permit risk. WACC/terminal-growth axes replaced: there is no terminal value and gold price is the dominant sensitivity (PFS tornado: +/-10% gold = +/-A$179m NPV).

permit_probability_sensitivity.note: Weighted IV (NZD) vs P(bear), base:bull held at 50:20
permit_probability_sensitivity.market_implied_note: At NZ$0.615 the market is pricing ~62% probability of the bear outcome at these scenario values — well above this model's 30%. The gap IS the investment debate.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Framed on the permit binary, not growth. GRANTED 70% (base 50 + bull 20): the project is named in the Fast-track Approvals Act itself, the government is explicitly pro-mining, hearings concluded Jun-2026, RFIs are being processed, and a draft decision is due Nov-2026 — a process this advanced is more likely than not to conclude in consent. REFUSED/VOIDED 30%: this is a genuine tail, not a token 5% — the statutory window has been extended three times (30 -> 60 -> 110-120 working days), four Otago iwi authorities allege inadequate s7 Treaty consultation that the panel chair acknowledged could in principle void the application, and opposition is nationally prominent (Sam Neill, Helen Clark, EDS). The share price falling 1.395 -> 0.62 against a RISING gold price is the market repricing exactly this risk.
probability_weighted.band_note: SBC ~A$0.1-0.6m/yr is immaterial: house and street bases coincide and the band collapses (SBC-zero convention, band_position null).

sanity_check.checks_replaced: P/E, P/B and EV/EBITDA are meaningless for a pre-revenue developer (every historical P/E negative, no EBITDA). Replaced with mining-developer checks: EV per resource/reserve ounce, P/NAV, and required-gold-price test.

ev_per_resource_oz.verdict: Market EV US$98/resource oz — top of the pre-permit band, justified by 2.1g/t grade, sealed-road/grid-hydro infrastructure, a completed PFS and a decision 3.5 months away.

ev_per_reserve_oz.note: US$184/reserve oz vs A$2,700-3,700/oz (~US$1,900-2,650) LOM margin at scenario gold prices

p_nav.verdict: Market pays 0.30x unrisked NPV6.5(A$4,950)+cash — inside the 0.2-0.5x pre-permit band. This model's weighted IV corresponds to ~0.49x unrisked spot NAV — top of that band, defensible with a decision due in 3.5 months, and does NOT require the market to pay >1x NAV. The permit haircut is applied once, explicitly, via the 30% bear weight rather than a P/NAV rule of thumb.

sanity_check.gold_price_test: Base uses A$4,500/oz — 25% below spot (~A$6,000) and 29% above the PFS base (A$3,500). Bull A$5,500 is below spot. No scenario requires gold above its current level, let alone above the sustained range.

valuation_philosophy.approach: Risked project-NPV (sum-of-parts) for a pre-revenue, single-asset gold developer
valuation_philosophy.summary: Santana has no revenue and no cash flow to discount — its value is a probability-weighted claim on the Bendigo-Ophir project NPV, contingent on one regulatory decision due 16 December 2026. We rebuild the PFS annual cash-flow profile, rescale it to conservative gold prices (base A$4,500/oz vs ~A$6,000 spot), re-discount at a 10-12% real equity rate instead of the PFS's 6.5% project rate, charge the A$92m+ funding gap as explicit dilution, and weight the whole thing 70/30 granted/refused. Refusal is not worth zero (A$185m cash, freehold land, a 2.34Moz resource) but at ~NZ$0.24 it is 60% below today's price.
valuation_philosophy.why_not_dcf: An owner-FCF DCF needs a margin history and a growth base; Santana's only 'FCF' is negative exploration spend. Projecting it would be meaningless.
valuation_philosophy.the_binary: Everything turns on the Fast-track decision. At NZ$0.615 the market implies ~62% odds of refusal at our scenario values; we judge ~30% from the process evidence (project named in the Act, hearings done, draft decision Nov-2026) against real legal risk (s7 Treaty challenge from four iwi authorities, three timeline extensions, prominent opposition). Neither number is knowable with precision — the honest statement is a range: NZ$0.24 if refused, NZ$1.00-1.70 if granted.
valuation_philosophy.what_would_change_our_mind: The Dec-2026 decision (or the Nov-2026 draft) collapses the tree. A refusal or s7 voiding moves fair value to ~NZ$0.24; a clean grant moves it toward NZ$1.00+ before any further gold-price help. A gold price back at the A$3,500 PFS base with a granted permit still supports ~NZ$0.71 at 8% — the gold cushion is real but not the main event.
valuation_philosophy.biggest_risk_to_the_model: Under-modelled dilution and the bear weight. If the post-consent raise prices below A$0.70, or refusal odds are nearer the market's ~62% than our 30%, weighted IV falls toward the current price.
